habits.en: Follow Setswana callers; rra and mma for sir and madam. Prices are in pula, not rand. Wallets: Orange Money, MyZaka.
habits.zh: 對方說塞茨瓦納語就跟著說；稱呼用 rra、mma。標價是普拉，不是蘭特。行動錢包常見 Orange Money、MyZaka。
